welcome:
Welcome! 🚗

I'll help you appeal a traffic fine in Israel.

Send me a photo or PDF of your fine notice and I will:
• Recognise the text (OCR)
• Extract the key details
• Generate a formal appeal letter in Hebrew

Maximum file size: 15 MB

help:
📖 Available commands:
/start — start
/appeal — generate appeal
/delete — delete my data
/language — change language
/help — help

After extraction, you can correct any field (fine number, violation, etc.) before generating the appeal. Press '❌ Data is incorrect' to fix fields, then choose an appeal reason.
